connector.name: Holded MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Holded - invoicing, accounting, CRM, projects, and team
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package holded-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the energio-es account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HOLDED_API_KEY
env.description: Your Holded API key. Get it from https://app.holded.com/api

env.name: HOLDED_MODULES
env.description: Comma-separated list of modules to enable (invoicing, crm, projects, accounting, team). All enabled by default.

env.name: HOLDED_RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND
env.description: API rate limit in requests per second. Default: 10.

env.name: HOLDED_DEBUG
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable debug logging for API requests.
